scope: Fixed-cardinality physical engine/SQL observations, SDK/authenticated metrics exports, raw workload phase/periodic capture, and strict independent delta validation. No performance improvement or capacity is established.

environment.validation: Native fixtures on macOS with real Raft-Engine, SQLite/LTX and native HTTP/TLS; embedded archive stores are InMemory. Tests are not 1-vCPU/3-GiB container qualification.
environment.profile_state: Stopped; no containers were launched for this change; other profiles unchanged.

toolchain: Rust 1.98.1; locked dependencies; all-feature matrix and Clippy; separate no-default-feature library check; test/dev debuginfo and incremental disabled; three build jobs.

observation_contract.scope: One opened engine/host; random source nonce changes on reopen. No per-cell/peer labels.
observation_contract.integer_encoding: Decimal strings for JSON u64 values; saturation and availability are explicit.
observation_contract.durations: Microseconds, all physical outcomes with an available owner clock. Derived quantiles are inclusive bucket upper bounds; null for no events or the unbounded final bucket.
observation_contract.bytes: Engine filesystem API and staged proposal/LTX/query bytes; excludes physical-device accounting, SQLite images, node metadata outside the adapter, S3 and network. Prepared output bytes precede admission/commit.
observation_contract.cancellation: Queue timers travel with queued work; physical SQL/fsync timers finish at the worker boundary even if the response waiter cancels. Abandoned is not rollback.
observation_contract.sampling: Per-operation coherent outcomes/histogram; cross-operation and byte counters are not transactional. Per-node HTTP sample windows are sequential. Boundary in-flight counts remain visible.

native_checks: A held real engine sync increments started without publishing completion; release records success; failed sync records failure and still quarantines reads. Persist group/entry/encoded-byte counters are checked against the actual write.
A canceled held SQL query retains physical work and unfinished timing; shutdown joins the reader and leaves complete outcome accounting on retained handles.

Generation-bound peer HTTP refuses wrong authentication, stale generation, duplicate/unknown views and unavailable startup. Resource view remains 110 samples; performance view has identical 266 identities at one and 32 initialized groups.
Production JSON snapshots from both native group populations pass the workload analyzer with nonzero engine/proposal/LTX counters. No synthetic native measurements are substituted.
Poisoned/saturated/dead-clock observations remain explicit; observation failures do not change business outcomes. JSON preserves u64 precision.

python.skip_scope: Existing opt-in Docker cache test; no physical Docker benchmark was run.

runner_validation: Tests refuse unavailable/duplicate/missing telemetry, changed sources, reset counters, impossible bucket deltas/sums, malformed decimals, saturation, phase overlap and fabricated performance reports. Current analyzer requires observations; earlier experiments remain pinned to their original analyzers.
